name: Heritage Orchard
description: Heritage Orchard is a working pumpkin patch in Lake Shore Drive, WI. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
